actor-start.eventDescription: Flat fee charged once per run, covering the Yahoo session handshake.

quote-row.eventDescription: One symbol's quote: price, change, open/high/low/previous close, volume, bid/ask, market cap, P/E, EPS, dividend, 52-week range, averages, pre/post-market fields.

history-100bars.eventDescription: Each started block of 100 history rows per symbol (OHLCV bars plus dividend and split rows). 1,260 daily bars over five years are 13 events.

fundamentals-module.eventDescription: One quoteSummary module for one symbol (summaryDetail, financialData, defaultKeyStatistics, incomeStatementHistory and so on) as plain numeric fields.

options-row.eventDescription: One call or put contract with strike, bid/ask, last, volume, open interest, implied volatility and computed Greeks.

search-row.eventDescription: One symbol matched by a search query, with exchange, type, sector and industry.

news-row.eventDescription: One headline for a symbol with publisher, link, publication time and related tickers.
